## 1. Unfiltered barcodes, compare to whitelist
load K562 detected barcodes
```{r}

load(file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root), verbose = T)
# Loading objects:
#   df.ld
#   df.whitelist

sum(df.bc_backbone$count)
# [1] 1082306
```

### 1.2. How many whitelist barcodes are found the k562 bc?
```{r}
# compute distance matrix
df.ld <- data.frame(lapply(df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq, function(x){stringdist(df.whitelist$bc, x, method = 'lv')} ))

colnames(df.ld) <- df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq
if (OUTPUT) {
save(df.ld, df.whitelist, df.bc_backbone,file=sprintf('%s/K562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root))
}
dim(df.ld)
# [1] 1261 5872

df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist <- data.frame(whitelist=df.whitelist$bc, 
                                        wellid=df.whitelist$wellid, 
                                        reads=0,k562_bc="")

for (row in 1:nrow(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist)){
  if(sum(df.ld[row,]<=1)>0){
    matched_bc.seq <- df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq[df.ld[row,]<=1]
    matched_bc.counts <- df.bc_backbone$count[df.ld[row,]<=1]
    matched_bc.Ld <- df.ld[row,][df.ld[row,]<=1]
    # remove matched_bc
    df.ld[row,df.ld[row,]<=1]=1000
    str1 <- ''
    for (i in 1:length(matched_bc.seq)){
      str1 <- sprintf('%s%s:%d:%d;',str1,matched_bc.seq[i],matched_bc.Ld[i],matched_bc.counts[i])
    }
    df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist[row,"reads"] <- sum(matched_bc.counts)
    df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist[row,"k562_bc"] <- str1
  }
}
# number of bcs matching whitelist (inc with d=1)
sum(df.ld==1000)
# [1] 2637

# how many whitelist bc without NGS support? 
sum(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist$reads==0)
# [1] 21

if (OUTPUT){
  save(df.ld, df.whitelist,df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist,
       df.bc_backbone,file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/Ld.post_matching.RData', analysis_root))
  write.csv(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/match_whitelist.csv', analysis_root),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
}
```
### 1.3. Many hight freq NGS barcodes do not match to whitelist (3236 bcs in total). 
Note that some will have mismatches to barcode patterns.
```{r}
# many NGS reads do not match to whitelist
load(file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root), verbose = T)
dim(df.ld)
# [1] 1261 5872: row - whitelist, col - k562
k562.not_wl_match_bc <- data.frame()
idx <- c()
for (col in 1:ncol(df.ld)){
  if (sum(df.ld[,col]<=1)==0){
    idx <- c(idx, colnames(df.ld)[col])
  }
}
k562.not_wl_match_bc <- data.frame(bc=idx)
k562.not_wl_match_bc$freq <- unname(sapply(idx, FUN=function(x)
  df.bc_backbone$count[df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq==x]))
if (OUTPUT) {
  write.csv(k562.not_wl_match_bc, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/NGS_bc_not_match_wl.csv', analysis_root),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
}
# num bc not in white list
dim(k562.not_wl_match_bc)
# [1] 3236    2
```

For the unique population, cluster the barcodes from k562.not_wl_match_bc (not filtered): 
```{r}
# the sequences are already in descending order of the count, so it is safe to merge
bc_cluster.count <- c()
bc_cluster.bc <- c()

k562.not_wl_match_bc.2 = k562.not_wl_match_bc|>arrange(desc(freq))
head(k562.not_wl_match_bc.2,1)
#                                                   bc freq
# 1 GCTCAGTCAGTGAGTTCGTACTATGCTCTTCAGGTATGACTAAGAGCGGT 3423
# compute d amounst unique barcodes
df.ld_unique_k562 <- data.frame(lapply(k562.not_wl_match_bc.2$bc,
                                       function(x){stringdist(k562.not_wl_match_bc.2$bc, x, method = 'lv')} ))
dim(df.ld_unique_k562)
# [1] 3236 3236

# start with all barcodes, end of each search set count for merged barcode to 0
for (row in 1:dim(df.ld_unique_k562)[1]){
  current_bc <- k562.not_wl_match_bc.2$bc[row]
  if (k562.not_wl_match_bc.2$freq[row]>0){
    idx_to_merge <- which(df.ld_unique_k562[row,]<=1)
    bc_cluster.count <- c(bc_cluster.count, sum(k562.not_wl_match_bc.2$freq[idx_to_merge]))
    bc_cluster.bc <- c(bc_cluster.bc, current_bc)
    k562.not_wl_match_bc.2$freq[idx_to_merge] = 0
  } 
}

df.unique_bc_clustered <- data.frame(barcode_seq = bc_cluster.bc, freq = bc_cluster.count)
# sum(df.bc_clustered$count)
df.unique_bc_clustered <- df.unique_bc_clustered[order(df.unique_bc_clustered$freq, decreasing = T),]
df.unique_bc_clustered.filtered <- df.unique_bc_clustered[df.unique_bc_clustered$freq>=100,]

if (OUTPUT) {
  write.csv(df.unique_bc_clustered, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/K562_unique_bc.clustered.csv', analysis_root),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
  write.csv(df.unique_bc_clustered.filtered, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/K562_unique_bc.clustered.filtered.csv', analysis_root),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
}
```

## 3. search plate1-5 bc_extract/, looking for bc matching filtered unique barcodes with d<=2.
### 3.2. output to df 
```{r}
bc.K562_unique <- read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/K562_unique_bc.clustered.filtered.csv', analysis_root))
rownames(bc.K562_unique) <- bc.K562_unique$barcode_seq
# head(bc.K562_unique)
#                                          barcode_seq freq
# 1 GCTCAGTCAGTGAGTTCGTACTATGCTCTTCAGGTATGACTAAGAGCGGT 3471
# 2 GCTCCTACAGAACGTTAAAACTTTACTCGACAGGAAGGACAAAGAGCGGT 2689

plate <- "plate1"

df.match_bc <- data.frame(matrix(data=NA, nrow=0, ncol=6))
colnames(df.match_bc) <- c("d","well_id","wellbc","wellbc.freq","k562_bc","k562_bc.freq")

# loop through each well on the plate
csvlist <- list.files(path=file.path(analysis_root, 'run2/bc_extract/', plate), 
           pattern = ".bc.csv")
for (csvname in csvlist) {
  print(csvname)
  # csvname <- csvlist[1]
  df.wellbc <- read.csv(file =file.path(analysis_root, 'run2/bc_extract/', plate, csvname))
  # row: wellbc, col: K562 bc
  df.ld <- data.frame(lapply(bc.K562_unique$barcode_seq, function(x){stringdist(df.wellbc$barcode_seq, x, method = 'lv')} ))
  # search each row (wellbc) to find matching bc
  for (id.wellbc in 1:nrow(df.ld)){
    id.k562bc <- which(df.ld[id.wellbc,]<=2)
    if (length(id.k562bc)>0) {
      tmp.df <- data.frame(d=unlist(unname(as.vector(df.ld[id.wellbc,id.k562bc]))),
                           well_id=rep(str_remove(csvname, '.bc.csv'),length(id.k562bc)), 
                           wellbc=rep(df.wellbc$barcode_seq[id.wellbc], length(id.k562bc)),
                           wellbc.freq=rep(df.wellbc$count[id.wellbc], length(id.k562bc)),
                           k562_bc=bc.K562_unique$barcode_seq[id.k562bc],
                           k562_bc.freq=bc.K562_unique$freq[id.k562bc]
                           )
      df.match_bc <- rbind(df.match_bc, tmp.df)
    }
  }
}
if (OUTPUT) {
  save(df.match_bc, bc.K562_unique, 
     file = sprintf('%s/K562/run1/v3/%s.rawbc_match_K562_unique_bc.Rdata', analysis_root, plate))
    # output matching to csv format
  for (plate in c("plate1","plate2","plate3","plate4","plate5")) {
    load(file = sprintf('%s/K562/run1/v3/%s.rawbc_match_K562_unique_bc.Rdata', 
                        analysis_root, plate), verbose = T)
    write.csv(df.match_bc, quote = F,
              file = sprintf('%s/K562/run1/v3/%s.rawbc_match_K562_unique_bc.csv', analysis_root, plate))
  }
}
```
